integrity: Proof uses orthogonal invariant theory, sign quotient and involution tangent representations; finite checks are corroborative, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: All complex projective squared rank-two Grassmannians with n>=5; reduced singular support and generic formal transverse types only. Component intersection schemes and positive characteristic are not classified. Direct rank-two projection determinantal-probability models first publicly available in arXiv:1207.6083v1 (2012-07-25); their complex algebraic closure is the variety studied here. General defining ideals/degree and n=4 singular components are previously published. Literature overlap beyond inspected sources cannot be ruled out.
title: Singular components and quotient types of squared two-plane Grassmannians
